Ava / Sean —

Reviewed the MAP. A few notes from infra/ops and my side:

- Security evidence: I will own SOC2 artifact collection. I'll need a short list from NPH security of the exact evidence types (logs, config snapshots, encryption certs).
- Integration testing: recommend we plan two 2-week test sprints (12/15-12/29 and 01/03-01/14) to account for holiday slowdowns.

Action items for handoff to CS:
- Sean: lead the kickoff meeting invite and own the integration test plan template.
- Monica: prepare the customer onboarding checklist and coordinate pre-prod access.

Putting proposed revised milestones here (concise):
- Sandbox ready: 2026-11-23 (Redwood: Karthik / infra)
- API contract sign-off: 2026-12-10 (Joint)
- Security evidence delivered: 2026-12-03 (Redwood: Karthik)
- First integration sprint: 2026-12-15 to 2026-12-29 (NPH + Redwood CS)
- Second integration sprint: 2027-01-03 to 2027-01-14 (NPH + Redwood CS)
- Go-live target: 2027-01-20 (contingent)

I'll attach the SOC2 evidence checklist separately early next week.

-Karthik
